sources.title: Multi — one task, the right AI workflow
sources.snippet: One prompt. Four ways to a better answer. Most AI apps hand you one model and hope it's the right one. Multi lets you ask a single model, compare a few side by side, convene a council of up to seven, or let Multi pick for you — all from the same prompt.

sources.title: Multi-Task Learning(MTL) for Deep Learning - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: Multi-Task Learning (MTL) is a machine learning approach where a single model learns multiple related tasks simultaneously using shared representations, improving generalization and reducing overfitting.

sources.title: Deep multi-task learning: a review of concepts, methods, and ... - Springer
sources.snippet: The authors in [7] have made a superior comparison of multi-task learning and single-task learning approaches. Single-task learning is a machine learning approach where a model is trained to perform only one specific task [8]. It also focuses exclusively on optimizing performance for a single objective [7].
